spans.text: At Griffin HQ.
...Pssst...pssst...
Isn't there any way to contact any of the commanders?
What about the Military? Any response from them yet?
Ma'am, we still haven't been able to establish communications with General Carter.
The engineers have already eliminated the possibility of Parapluie interference. Right now they're checking the pathway to see if it was damaged by Sangvis Ferri.
...Understood. Keep trying until you get through.
Ma'am, a Griffin T-Doll beyond Parapluie's coverage radius is trying to open comms with us.
We've authenticated her identity and she's not infected. Shall we allow the connection?
(Could she be a messenger from one of the commanders?)
Permission granted.
...Click.
This is Gr MP7. "Caretaker of Caretakers", can you hear me?
"Caretaker of Caretakers"...Could that be me?
I'm a messenger sent by my "Caretaker". I ran all the way out of the jamming radius by myself to make contact with HQ...Hello? Hello?
Go on, Gr MP7. What is the current situation out there?
It's terrible, but not terminal. Our Caretaker is reorganizing our echelons.
It's been a struggle, but we managed to gather all the Griffin T-Dolls in sight and we're preparing to continue our retreat to Area S11.

We've been attacked by both Sangvis forces and Parapluie-infected military units. There hasn't been any response to our attempts at communicating with the Military, so I'm guessing they've left us for dead.
Mind your language, Gr MP7. Do not make any statements that cast aspersions on the Military.
Return to your Caretaker with these orders from HQ: the top priority now is to retreat to a safe area, and if conditions permit, you may rescue other Griffin allies, both humans and T-Dolls.
Your Caretaker has discretion over the exact orders to be issued, but they are to stand by for further instructions once the withdrawal to Area S11 is complete.
Sure, I can do that...
But things being what they are now, is everything okay over there with you and the "Caretaker's Boss"?
The Commander is worried that HQ would suddenly...you won't let me say it, but you know what I mean, right?
HQ is safe, you don't need to worry. Ensure your own survival first.
At the very least we know that you're alive. That's good news. Thank you, Gr MP7.
This conversation is over. Thank you for your hard work. Go back and make your report.
Got it, Caretaker of Caretakers. Good luck to you too.
...Click.
The transmission ends.
After this, all I need to do is send the info back via drone...
Caretaker said that I didn't have to return to the battlefield once I managed to escape, so...
...Gr MP7 sighs.
I can't do it after all. It simply isn't our team's style.
My candy won't taste good if I back out of an operation before I've expended all my ammo!
I'll go help those idiots out some more.
...Gr MP7 charges back into the fray of the combat zone.
